articles.title: New Report Shows Prices Rising Faster Than Expected
articles.summary: A new report shows US prices rose 3.7 percent from a year ago, faster than expected, with costs climbing for many everyday items.

articles.title: Ukraine's Military Faces Limits on Starlink Satellite Service
articles.summary: Ukraine's military has lost some access to Starlink satellite internet, and Elon Musk says any limits would have come from the U.S. government.

articles.title: Social Security Payments Will Rise 3.6 Percent in 2027
articles.summary: Social Security payments will go up 3.6 percent in 2027 to help older Americans and others keep up with rising prices.
